artworks.title: Queen Christina of Sweden
artworks.artist: Alexandre Tardieu after Sébastien Bourdon after Charles Auguste van den Berghe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up. The subject is positioned facing slightly to the viewer's left, with their body turned to the side while their head is facing forward. They have long, curly hair that flows past their shoulders. Their facial expression is neutral, and they have delicate facial features. The person is wearing a flowing garment with voluminous sleeves, which appears to be a dress or gown, draped elegantly. A string of pearls adorns their neck, and they hold a small bunch of flowers in their right hand. The background is a textured, dark area that enhances the contrast with the subject, and there is a hint of a curtain to the right side of the image.

artworks.title: Jean Restout
artworks.artist: Jean Charles Levasseur after Jean Bernard Restout
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man seated from the waist up. His head is turned towards the viewer, displaying detailed facial features including a strong jawline and alert eyes. He has tight curls hairstyle typical of the 18th century. The man wears an ornate coat over a shirt with a folded collar. He is holding a paintbrush and a palette, indicating his profession. In the background, an oval frame with the inscription "J. Restout" is visible. The engraving's border is textured, with a classical and formal design.

artworks.title: Le Comte de Caylus
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of "Le Comte de Caylus," focusing on the head and neck in profile. The person's face is in a side profile, looking to the left with a pronounced nose and wavy, short hair. The individual is not wearing clothing around the neck, resembling a classical bust. The engraving is within an ornate circular frame with a plaque below stating "Le Comte de Caylus." The background is a textured surface providing depth to the portrait.

artworks.title: Marie-Antoinette
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a woman in profile facing left. She has delicate features, an intricate updo, and wears a garment with puffed sleeves, lace, and bows. The image is framed by floral decorations and features an inscription and decorative shield with symbols.

artworks.title: Marie-Antoinette
artworks.artist: Nicolas Dupin after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in profile facing left, with classical features and elaborate hair. They wear a textured garment and the background features oval frames and descriptive text.

artworks.title: Antoine Coyzevox
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man shown from the waist up. He is positioned facing slightly to the right, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. The man has curly, shoulder-length hair. His facial features include a round face with a prominent nose. He is wearing a loose-fitting cloak draped around his shoulders over a buttoned inner garment. In the area surrounding him, there are two tools, including a mallet resting against the stone ledge upon which he leans. The background features an intricately detailed stone frame.

artworks.title: Nicholas Bertin
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a portrait of a man shown from the waist up. He is seated and positioned within an oval frame, turning slightly to his left with his head turned in profile. The man has a full head of curly, shoulder-length hair and a strong, well-defined face with a prominent nose. He is dressed in a loose garment with a partially open shirt underneath, which has a slightly crumpled collar. His left hand holds a painter's palette with visible paint dabs, while his right hand rests on an artist's brush. Around him, there are artistic elements like a rolled-up sheet of paper and books. The background contains detailed moulding, emphasizing the ornate appearance of the oval frame. The bottom of the engraving has an inscription with his name, "Nicolas Bertin," and descriptive text.

artworks.title: Carle Vanloo
artworks.artist: Ignaz Sebastian Klauber after Pierre Le Sueur
artworks.description: The image shows a man's portrait from the waist up. He is seated in a chair, holding a book or sketchpad in one hand and a drawing instrument in the other. The man has refined facial features, curly hair, and is dressed in an 18th-century outfit with intricate details. The background is plain, and the chair has a patterned fabric. The text "CARLE VANLOO" is visible at the bottom of the portrait.

artworks.title: Louis Michel Vanloo
artworks.artist: Simon Charles Miger after Louis Michel Van Loo
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two men. One man is seated in a three-quarter pose, facing slightly right with a hand resting on a chair's back. He has a round face with a prominent chin and direct eye contact. His hair is wavy, styled back, and he wears an ornate outfit with a textured coat over a detailed vest and collared shirt. In the background, another man is standing to the right, with similar hairstyle and attire, near a large canvas or easel.

artworks.title: Gaspard Duchange
artworks.artist: Nicolas-Gabriel Dupuis after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a man in profile, showing his head and upper body facing right. The man has a prominent nose, a slight smile, and curly hair typical of the 18th century. He wears formal attire with no visible jewelry. The portrait is in an oval frame with a textured background and the text "GASPARD DUCHANCE" below.

artworks.title: Frontispiece
artworks.medium: etching in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: An open book with visible text titled "The Parable of the Prodigal Son." The image features two pages with elaborate text and detailed borders. The color palette is primarily sepia tones with beige giving the impression of aged paper. The book is positioned centrally, lying open with two pages visible, strings trailing from its corners, and script detailing in the bottom right corner where it indicates the creator "J.J. Tissot" and the date "1881."

artworks.title: The Departure
artworks.description: The image displays four figures in an interior setting centered around a wooden table. On the left, a woman is sitting next to the table. Next to her, a man is seated, looking out of the window. In the middle, a young man stands facing an elderly man sitting across the table. On the right, an older man is seated, leaning forward with hands clasped on the table. On the table, there's a tray with a teapot, cups, and flowers. Through the window, there's a partial view of a ship's rigging. Along the wall, shelves with model ships and other maritime artifacts are visible.

artworks.title: In Foreign Climes
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a detailed interior scene with various figures engaged in different activities. The figures are depicted in traditional garments, some holding fans and others appearing to observe or interact. The room is decorated with lanterns and patterned flooring, creating a cultural or festive ambiance. The artwork captures expressions and interactions within the setting.

artworks.title: The Return
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nautical scene with livestock and people aboard a ship. The scene depicts figures engaged in various activities on the ship's deck. Some figures are handling swine. Two figures in the center are embracing. The detailed lines show the ship's rigging and wooden deck. Other figures and elements of the ship are visible in the background. The drawing conveys a sense of narrative and emotion through its detailed depiction of figures and their actions.

artworks.title: The Fatted Calf
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people seated at a table outdoors under a shaded canopy. One figure with his back to the viewer is turned towards another person kneeling outside the pavilion. The kneeling person has short hair, a moustache, and is looking up towards the table. At the table, a man with a moustache is holding a carving knife and a fork. Three other figures are seated at the table, one facing directly towards the viewer. A dog is resting beside the table, looking towards the individuals. The environment includes trees with dense foliage and a body of water in the background.

artworks.title: Cuirassier retenant son cheval qui se cabre
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a soldier holding the reins of a rearing horse. The image depicts a historical or military scene with a soldier dressed in a uniform, complete with a plumed helmet and cape, as he controls a spirited horse that is rearing up. The horse has its tack and saddle decorated in a classic manner. The background shows other soldiers and horses, emphasizing the military theme. The drawing's monochromatic palette highlights shading and line work to convey texture and movement.

artworks.title: Five Women on the Street
artworks.description: Printed with bold, black, angular lines and slashes on white paper, five stylized women stand in a loose row across the width of this vertical woodcut. All five wear long, dark coats or dresses. The leftmost woman wears a turban-like hat, and the others have hats topped with long plumes. Their bodies are narrow and taper to their feet, and all the women appear to stand with hands in pockets except the frontmost, who braces one hand on her hip. Their features are roughly carved with almond shapes or slits for eyes, thickly outlined lips, heavy eyebrows, and some horizontal shading on the cheeks. The all face our left in profile except the leftmost woman, who faces us. Some abstracted forms, including a wheel, fill the right quarter of the composition. The rest of the background is white except for some carving marks that printed black.

artworks.title: The Testing of the King's Sons
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.1 x 24.3 cm (6 3/4 x 9 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring multiple figures. The image portrays a group of figures in elaborate clothing, with one figure on horseback and others engaged in a dialogue. The background shows a landscape with hills and trees. One figure appears disheveled and possibly distressed, contrasting with the others. The drawing shows detailed line work and attention to costume and expressions.

artworks.title: A Villefranche-sur-Mer
artworks.medium: etching with monoprint inking on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a shaded area beneath a thick canopy of branches extending towards the center. A high horizon line showcases an expansive body of water. Vague silhouettes of distant structures are visible on the horizon. The artwork features intricate dark lines for dense foliage and contrasting highlights indicating sunlight. The color scheme is monochromatic, with primarily black and brown shades creating a dramatic effect. A figure stands on a path close to the water, partially obscured by shadow.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.description: The image shows several figures in a seated position on the ground. In the center is a woman holding a child. A man with a beard is seated beside them. Two winged figures are above them, possibly angels. Nearby are a cow and a donkey. The background includes architectural elements and a rustic landscape. The scene is depicted with detailed line work in an etching style.

artworks.title: The Mystic Marriage of Saint Catherine
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 18 x 13.4 cm (7 1/16 x 5 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The etching shows the upper three-quarters of three figures. The central figure, a woman, is seated with her body turned slightly to the left. She has gentle facial features and wears a hood or headscarf, with long hair peeking out underneath. Her clothing is draped elegantly in soft, naturalistic folds, and she is looking down at a small child sitting on her lap. The child is mostly unclothed, save for a cloth around the waist, and is leaning towards the woman as they hold hands. To the right, there is another woman, seated and leaning gently towards the central figure. She has similarly soft facial features, her hair is styled back with a headband or a simple crown, and she wears a garment with long sleeves and embroidered details, including a prominent flower on the shoulder. This woman appears to be holding the central figure's hand. The background features a large tree with flowing branches above the group and a distant, softly etched landscape, including clouds and possibly a body of water in the background.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of Alexander Longhi. He is shown facing forward with his head slightly turned. Longhi has distinctive facial features, including prominent eyebrows, a straight nose, and full lips. His hair is styled or covered with a cloth, possibly a turban. He is wearing a cloak or coat draped over his shoulders. The portrait is set within an ornate baroque-style frame featuring intricate scrollwork, decorative motifs, and figures of women. Below the portrait, artist tools like a paint palette and brushes are incorporated into the framing. The inscription "Alexander Longhi Pictor" is at the bottom of the image. The background includes detailed engravings with decorative patterns and motifs.

artworks.title: Jason and the Dragon
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 34.5 x 21.8 cm (13 9/16 x 8 9/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Neil and Sharon Phillips
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a knight battling a dragon. The artwork shows a knight fighting a dragon. The knight is central in the image, wearing armor and holding a sword. The dragon is large with detailed features such as wings, scales, and claws. The scene includes the dragon's tail and is shaded to create depth. The background features swirling lines indicating a forest.

artworks.title: The Eritrean Sibyl
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical architectural and sculptural ceiling design. The image features a central seated figure, flanked by smaller figures and decorative elements. The main figure sits atop a ledge with draped garments detailed to convey movement and weight. Below, two seated figures are positioned under an architectural arch. Above them are smaller nude figures in a muscular style, holding positions in the design. The architectural elements suggest a high level of detail and perspective, typical of Renaissance drawings.
